sloka: जीवेयम् खलु सौमित्रे मया सह सुमध्यमा ।सेवेत यदि वैदेही पम्पायाः पवनम् शुभम् ॥४-१-१०३॥
transliteration: jīveyam khalu saumitre mayā saha sumadhyamā ।seveta yadi vaidehī pampāyāḥ pavanam śubham ॥4-1-103॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri I can be alive and happy if Sita of slender waist enjoys here with me the sweet breeze of Pampa.
